title: Notifier behind an interface
prompt: Implement in `Solution`: interface `INotifier { string Send(string message); }`; classes `EmailNotifier` (returns `"email: " + message`) and `SmsNotifier` (returns `"sms: " + message`); and `static string Broadcast(INotifier n, string message)` returning `n.Send(message)`.

tests.name: normal
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.Broadcast(new Solution.EmailNotifier(), "hi"), "email: hi", "email flavor");
Cj.Eq(Solution.Broadcast(new Solution.SmsNotifier(), "hi"), "sms: hi", "sms flavor");
tests.hint: Broadcast depends only on the contract; the flavor comes from the object.

tests.name: swap
tests.hint: One loop, both implementations — code written against the interface never changes when flavors are added.
